articles.title: How Much Of Qualcomm Stock Rides On One Business?
articles.description: Phone chip revenue is the central metric to watch at Qualcomm (QCOM). Handset chips generated $5.1 billion in fiscal Q3 2026, accounting for more than half of the company's $9.9 billion in revenue. Total revenue fell 4.0% from a year earlier, and a segment that makes up more than half of sales deserves close attention. So what is hurting Qualcomm's phone chip sales.
